difficulty_reason: The selected single-graph realization requires a new upper bound for rooted-tree blowups through heavy-star exclusion, control of rich copies with fixed leaves and a full double-counting construction. The proof must convert these copy families into a sufficiently unbalanced bipartite subgraph and verify the quantitative p,q interface that forces the required blowup, not simply apply the ordinary balanced-tree lower bound. The precise cited lower-bound and exponent-bootstrap prerequisites leave those complete new structural and quantitative obligations in the definitions and claims 2.1–2.9 of Section 2, so the selected main realization is one substantive research result rather than an auxiliary parameter restatement.
